events.summary: Hey residents! 👋 We're thrilled to share that Hokko Spaces launches on 29th October on Steam. We're so excited for players to get hands-on with the full game at the end of the month! Hokko Spaces is a creative sandbox game! You'll design miniature diorama worlds and complete tasks to unlock villagers.
